wardrobeAccountGuestTitle: Sign in to dress up and collect
wardrobeAccountGuestBody: After signing in, conversations and tasks can drop bottles with outfits or character cards. Guest drops are previews, not bottles you can open.
wardrobeAccountSigningIn: Finish signing in in your browser…
wardrobeAccountInviteHint: Got a friend's invite code? Enter it under Invite after signing in for 2 extra bottles.
wardrobeAccountGuestItemHint: Sign in to change your look and earn chances to collect outfits and character cards.
wardrobeAccountLockedShopTitle: The feather shop needs a Kun account
wardrobeAccountLockedInviteTitle: Inviting friends needs a Kun account
wardrobeAccountLockedBody: Once you sign in, duplicate outfits turn into feathers you can trade here for bottles, and inviting friends earns bottles for both of you.
wardrobeAccountError_anonymous: Sign in to your Kun account first.
wardrobeAccountError_expired: Your sign-in expired. Please sign in again.
wardrobeAccountError_network: Network connection failed. Please try again.
wardrobeAccountError_service: The account service is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
wardrobeAccountError_invalid_request: That request was not valid. Refresh and try again.
wardrobeAccountError_not_enough_feathers: Not enough feathers. Duplicate outfits earn more.
wardrobeAccountError_offer_limit_reached: You've reached today's limit for this item. Come back tomorrow.
wardrobeAccountError_offer_unavailable: This item is no longer available.
wardrobeAccountError_shelf_full: Your shelf is full. Open some bottles first.
wardrobeAccountError_item_unknown: That outfit could not be found.
wardrobeAccountError_look_item_locked: That outfit is not unlocked yet.
wardrobeAccountError_bottle_not_found: That bottle has already been opened.
wardrobeAccountError_invite_code_invalid: That invite code is not valid. Check it and try again.
wardrobeAccountError_invite_self: You can't use your own invite code.
wardrobeAccountError_invite_already_clai: You've already entered an invite code.
wardrobeAccountError_invite_mutual: You invited this person, so you can't invite each other.
wardrobeAccountError_invite_window_close: Invite codes can only be entered within 7 days of signing up.
wardrobeShopIntro: Duplicate outfits turn into feathers. Trade feathers for bottles, or for an outfit you don't own yet.
wardrobeShopTenNote: a ten-pull has at least one rare
wardrobeShopBought: Got {{n}} bottle(s); they're on your shelf
wardrobeShopExchangeBody: Pick an unknown item you don't own in the wardrobe and pay feathers by rarity. It's revealed after the trade.
wardrobeShopWhere: Where feathers come from: opening an outfit you own or a role card already lit gives {{values}} feathers for common / rare / epic / legendary. Events give feathers too.
wardrobeInviteBody: When a friend signs up with your link or code and finishes a first chat or task in Kun, you both get bottles.
wardrobeInviteMessage: I'm using Kun, a desktop assistant that codes, researches and organizes documents. Sign up with my invite link and you'll get {{n}} bottles with new Kun outfits after your first use: {{link}} (code {{code}})
wardrobeInviteNone: Send it to a friend who'd like to try Kun. After their first use you get {{n}} bottles and they get {{m}}.
wardrobeInviteClaimTitle: Have a friend's invite code? Enter it for {{n}} extra bottles
wardrobeInviteClaimBody: You can enter one within 7 days of signing up. Pasting the invite link works too.
wardrobeInviteClaimedPaid: Invite code accepted; {{n}} bottles are on your shelf
wardrobeInviteClaimedPending: Invite code accepted; your {{n}} bottles arrive after your first use of Kun
wardrobeInviteByPaid: You accepted a friend's invitation and your {{n}} welcome bottles have arrived.
wardrobeInviteByPending: You accepted a friend's invitation. Your {{n}} welcome bottles arrive after your first chat or task in Kun.
wardrobeInviteRuleNew: Your friend needs a new Kun account and must use your link or code within 7 days of signing up.
wardrobeInviteRuleActive: Rewards for both of you arrive after your friend's first chat or task in the Kun desktop app.
wardrobeInviteRuleCap: You can earn up to {{n}} invite rewards a month; after that your friends still get their welcome bottles.
wardrobeInviteRulePrivacy: You can't use your own code, and two accounts can't invite each other. To protect privacy, friends' names and emails are never shown.
wardrobeGuestDropBody: Sign in for a chance to earn bottles and draw outfits or character cards. This is a preview; collecting starts after sign-in.
